title: js-yaml: locate why some hex integers load as strings
prompt: In this copy of js-yaml, some hexadecimal integers are loaded as strings instead of numbers: `a: 0xdeadbeef` gives the number 3735928559 but `a: 0xDEADBEEF` gives the string "0xDEADBEEF", and `dump({a: '0xDEADBEEF'})` no longer quotes that string, so it would not round-trip. Find the root cause and fix it with a minimal change; all other integer forms must keep working.
